title: Vuln-Scan Findings Schema
description: Output contract of the vuln-scan skill (<repo>-vuln-findings.json, harness >= 0.38.0). Shares vocabulary with report.schema.json: the severity_level enum is identical and finding ids use the canonical {REPO_SLUG}-{SHORTSHA}-{NNN} campaign pattern. Findings are UNVERIFIED candidates ('claimed' in findings-lifecycle terms) awaiting /triage; known_findings are candidates deduped against the target's *-security-audit.json baseline. Legacy VULN-FINDINGS.json files (pre-0.38.0) do not conform and are not auto-detected against this schema.

findings.$comment: Empty is valid: a clean sweep (or one where every candidate matched the baseline) yields zero new findings.

review_surface_coverage.description: Review-surface coverage of the scanned code (the whole tree, or the diff for a --diff scan): one entry per surface. A surface the diff does not touch is out_of_scope. The cumulative builder merges this record into the repo's cumulative report (*-findings-current.json).

allOf.$comment: out_of_scope is for a diff-scoped scan only. A record that answers any surface out_of_scope must carry the --diff stamp, metadata.additional.coverage_diff; a full scan records what it found on every surface.

repo_slug.description: Repo name uppercased, [^A-Z0-9] -> '_', truncated to 24 chars — the id prefix.

scanned_ref.description: Short SHA of the scanned commit (7 lowercase hex), or '0000000 (not a git checkout)'.

harness_version.description: Harness semver + short SHA at scan time, e.g. 0.38.0-de5a090.

baseline.description: Path of the matched <repo>-security-audit.json, or null when the target has no audit baseline.

additional.description: Extension bag (same convention as report.schema.json): deterministic_steps recording, the --diff mode coverage_diff stamp, and the spend calibration stamp. Undeclared keys stay allowed.

coverage_diff.description: Present exactly when the scan was diff-scoped (/vuln-scan --diff): what the diff was taken against and what of it the scan covered. A full scan omits it. A review_surface_coverage entry may be out_of_scope only when this is present.

changed_files_covered.description: Changed first-party files the scan reviewed.

callers_covered.description: Callers of changed code the scan reviewed.

refused_or_skipped.description: Each changed file or step not covered, as '<file or step>: <reason>'.

baseline_report.description: The audit report the diff was resolved against.

anchor.description: The commit the diff starts from (the baseline's metadata.commit).

resolution_source.description: How the baseline and anchor were chosen: auto (the resolver) or override (--since / --baseline).

id.$comment: Canonical campaign id only — this artifact type postdates the legacy id scheme.

scanner_ref.description: The review subagent's working id (F-<focus>-<n>), kept for traceability.

line.$comment: Null when the scanner could only cite the enclosing function (the description must say so).

cwe.description: Primary CWE for the category; feeds the baseline fold-in's required cwes[].

fingerprint.description: Deterministic cross-scan identity (identity module fingerprint). Optional here -- no artifact of this kind carries one today -- but DECLARED, because additionalProperties is false and an undeclared identity field makes every stamped artifact invalid the moment a producer starts emitting it. That has happened twice: report.schema.json omitted fingerprint_algo for 16 days, and the cloud-config schema declared neither, so stamping the policy findings invalidated nearly every report in one command.

fingerprint_algo.description: Algorithm version of `fingerprint` (the identity module ALGO_VERSION). Declared for the same reason as `fingerprint` above.

matches_baseline_id.description: The baseline audit finding this candidate duplicates.
